description: This file defines the 'LoanAccountData' class, which encapsulates comprehensive information about a loan account within the Fineract platform. It includes fields for basic loan details, terms, settings, associated entities, template options, and various behaviors. The class provides static factory methods for creating instances from individual or group loans, as well as methods for associating related data such as product info, member variations, and template options. It also contains utility methods for fetching borrower cycle defaults and comparing loan accounts by client name.

classes.name: LoanAccountData
classes.description: A data container class representing all relevant information about a loan account, including details, terms, settings, associations, and methods for construction and comparison.

methods.name: importInstanceIndividual
methods.description: Creates a new LoanAccountData instance for an individual loan, initializing fields based on provided parameters such as client ID, product ID, loan officer, dates, and financial terms.

methods.name: importInstanceGroup
methods.description: Creates a new LoanAccountData instance for a group loan, initializing fields for group-specific details and parameters.

methods.name: withClientData
methods.description: Associates client data with the LoanAccountData instance, populating client-related fields.

methods.name: withExpectedDisbursementDate
methods.description: Sets the expected disbursement date for the loan, initializing timeline data if necessary.

methods.name: withProductData
methods.description: Populates loan account fields based on a given LoanProductData object and loan cycle number, calculating default values and setting various attributes.

methods.name: basicLoanDetails
methods.description: Constructs a LoanAccountData object with core loan details such as ID, account number, status, financial terms, and related metadata, suitable for listing or summary purposes.

methods.name: associationsAndTemplate
methods.description: Populates the LoanAccountData instance with associated entities and template options needed for UI or further processing.

methods.name: associateMemberVariations
methods.description: Associates borrower cycle variations with the loan account based on provided member loan cycles, defaulting values where applicable.

methods.name: withInterestRecalculationCalendarData
methods.description: Sets the calendar data used for interest recalculation calculations within the loan account.

methods.name: toLoanChargeData
methods.description: Converts a ChargeData object into a LoanChargeData object for internal use within loan transactions.

methods.name: fetchLoanCycleDefaultValue
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve default values for borrower cycles, based on certain conditions and variation data.
